title.en: An Act to Amend Act Numbered Twenty-Six Hundred and Ninety-Nine, Entitled "An Act to Provide Certain Facilities for the Administration of the Manila Railroad Company," Extending the Period of Tax Exemption of Said Company.

text.en:
Section four of Act Numbered Twenty-six hundred and ninety-nine, entitled "An Act to provide
certain facilities for the administration of the Manila Railroad Company," is hereby amended to read as
"Section 4. The Manila Railroad Company is hereby exempted, until December thirty-first, nineteen hundred
and twenty, from all taxes of every name and nature, either municipal, provincial, or Insular, upon its capital
stock, franchises, right-of-way, earnings, and upon all property owned or operated by it.
"Until December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and twenty, no specific tax shall be collected on any article
sold and delivered directly to the Manila Railroad Company."

This Act shall take effect as of January first, nineteen hundred and nineteen.
Approved, March 13, 1919.
